answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils through slashable capital staking. Agents lock escrowed collateral at an admission wharf, while unproven candidates remain in a sable quarantine tier. Misbehavior triggers stake slashing, forcing adversaries to commit scarce liquid capital per identity to survive a constant tide of validation challenges. However, this creates steep financial barriers for low-budget agents and cannot deter well-funded cartels.
